candidates.exact_span:
The facility shall have a 1-year compliance schedule to achieve final
limitations for Cyanide pollutant. The permit will require compliance schedule reports.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether Cyanide is governed by interim compliance-schedule limitations versus final enforceable numeric limits in FY2025 affects which limit applies for compliance comparison (A) and whether compliance-schedule reporting is an applicable obligation (B).

candidates.exact_span:
The preliminary toxic analysis, also, shows potential for RP to exist, based on insufficiently
sensitive test methods used, for Cadmium, 2,3,7,8-TCDD Dioxin, Pentachlorophenol, Aldrin,
Chlordane and Toxaphene pollutants.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of reasonable-potential findings tied to method sensitivity affects whether enforceable numeric limits versus monitoring-only requirements apply (A), whether quarterly monitoring is triggered (B), and how missing or nondetect results for these parameters should be classified when methods may be insufficiently sensitive (C).

candidates.exact_span:
Because the permittee has not met the sufficient sensitive
test requirement per 40 CFR 122.21(e)(3), EPA proposes monitoring for these parameters
quarterly n the draft permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether the 122.21(e)(3) sensitive-test condition is treated as satisfied or unsatisfied changes whether quarterly monitoring is actually required (B) and whether absent results reflect conditional non-requirement versus missing required evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span:
During the public comment period, the permittee may submit the
analysis results using EPA approved methods with SSM complied MDL (shown in parenthesis)
for Cadmium (0.05 ug/L, EPA 200.9) , 2,3,7,8-TCDD Dioxin (1.0E-5 ug/L, EPA 1613B),
Pentachlorophenol (7.4 ug/L, EPA 604), Aldrin (0.004 ug/L, EPA 608), Chlordane (0.014 ug/L,
EPA 608), and Toxaphene (0.24 ug/L, EPA 608)).
candidates.computation_change_reason: Different readings of whether SSM-compliant MDL analyses were submitted, and which method/MDL pair governs each parameter, can change applicable monitoring obligations (B), whether numeric compliance comparisons are possible at stated detection levels (A), and how no-data or below-MDL results are semantically classified (C).

candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this reconsideration condition is treated as met changes whether quarterly monitoring remains required (B) and whether missing monitoring during FY2025 reflects documented conditional non-requirement versus unresolved required monitoring (C).
